dataset: NLUT official videos, three-video prompt-only challenge split

protocol.task: target video plus text prompt to graded video, without visual reference or ground truth
protocol.selection: three additional official NLUT videos selected before method execution for distinct highlight, skin, foliage, and motion challenges
protocol.frame_policy: first 72 frames at native cadence, long side capped at 512 pixels
protocol.reference_policy: no reference image, video, palette statistics, LUT, or hidden visual prior
protocol.aggregation: compute each metric per prompt-video pair and macro-average

samples.instruction: Create a polished modern neo-noir city-night grade. Establish deep cool blue-black shadows with visible building separation, selectively emphasize cyan and magenta neon, and preserve small warm amber windows as contrasting accents. Keep the skyline neutral enough to avoid a global blue wash. Use a firm black toe, controlled midtone contrast, and a soft highlight shoulder that retains sign lettering, tower lights, and colored reflections on the water. Avoid crushed buildings, clipped neon, radioactive saturation, muddy reflections, halos, or frame-to-frame pumping.

Grade this park sequence as a restrained late-1970s 35mm ensemble drama. Give sunlit foliage muted ochre and olive character, keep faces naturally warm and separated, cool the open shadows slightly, and subordinate modern electric-blue clothing without losing fabric detail. Use a gently lifted toe, moderate filmic contrast, quiet saturation, warm cream highlights, and a soft shoulder. Preserve individual skin tones, hair, tree texture, and moving pedestrians. Avoid orange skin, brown monochrome foliage, cyan shadows, clipped pavement, crushed coats, or temporal color shifts.

Create a refined photochemical bleach-bypass outdoor-adventure grade. Build dense but separated forest shadows, restrained moss and foliage chroma, cool silver-cyan water, and crisp neutral-white rapids. Keep sunlit rocks subtly warm so the scene retains depth. Increase controlled midtone contrast and texture while using a compact soft shoulder to preserve foam and wet-stone highlights. Avoid radioactive greens, uniform cyan contamination, clipped white water, black foliage holes, crunchy halos, excessive sharpening, or flicker in the moving rapids.
